titulo: Checking the dictionary before it goes out
caption:
Checking the dictionary before it goes out

Her spelling was confident and wrong. She checked the dictionary and fixed it before it went anywhere.

Checking takes a few seconds, and a small mistake is easiest to fix before anyone else sees it.

For whoever checks the book instead of guessing.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a thick blue book standing on the right and an ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left, trembling with narrowed eyes. A bubble says definately? Its eyes go wide, it walks to the book, the book opens and a page turns. A new bubble says definitely. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me so sure I can spell it, to: looked it up. glad I did.
